title: VillagerBased PlayerShops
description: Player-owned villager shops, server-side. Spawn a shop villager and sell through player-stocked trades — customers buy via the vanilla merchant screen, so they need nothing installed.
body:
# Villager Shop

Give players their own **villager-run shops** — no plugins, fully server-side.

`/shop create` spawns an **invulnerable shop villager** with no breakable block behind it. Owners stock their own trades through a **chest-based setup GUI** — rename the shop, pick the villager's profession and biome variant, toggle glow, set rotation, and manage paged stock/payment screens. Customers buy through the **vanilla merchant screen**, so they need nothing installed.

## Features
- `/shop create` — spawn a player-owned shop villager
- Player-stocked trades configured through a chest setup GUI
- Customize name, profession, biome variant, glow, and rotation
- Paged stock & payment screens
- Customers use the normal villager trade screen (vanilla-client friendly)

## Requires
- Minecraft **26.2** · Fabric Loader **0.19.3+** · Fabric API **0.152.1+** · Java **25**
